25658-daisy-ashford-her-book.title: Daisy Ashford Her Book
25658-daisy-ashford-her-book.creator: Unknown
25658-daisy-ashford-her-book.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. he lamentable consequences to whoever it was who, probably by the process of eating a mess of miscellaneous wild fungoids, disclosed to a bereaved family and a benefited world the important fact that certain mushrooms were nourishing and certain toadstools were fatal.

53155-out-and-about-london.title: Out And About London
53155-out-and-about-london.creator: Thomas Burke
53155-out-and-about-london.description: A book by Thomas Burke. ed morning--one of those rare mornings when London seems to laugh before you, disclosing her random beauties. In every park the trees were hung with adolescent tresses, green and white and yellow, and the sky was busy with scudding clouds.

arxiv-1907-01618.title: Impacts of radiative corrections on measurements of lepton flavour universality in B → D ​ ℓ ​ ν ℓ {B}\rightarrow{D}\ell{{\nu}_{\ell}} decays
arxiv-1907-01618.creator: S. Klaver
arxiv-1907-01618.description: Abstract Radiative corrections to B → D ​ ℓ ​ ν ℓ {B}\rightarrow{D}\ell{{\nu}_{\ell}} decays can have an impact on predictions and measurements of the lepton universality ratios ℛ ⁡ ( D + ) \mathcal{R}({{D}^{+}}) and ℛ ⁡ ( D 0 ) \mathcal{R}({{D}^{0}}) .

arxiv-2012-01506.title: Few-Shot Classification with Feature Map Reconstruction Networks
arxiv-2012-01506.creator: Davis Wertheimer Luming Tang Bharath Hariharan Cornell University {dww78,lt453,bh497}@cornell.edu
arxiv-2012-01506.description: Abstract In this paper we reformulate few-shot classification as a reconstruction problem in latent space. The ability of the network to reconstruct a query feature map from support features of a given class predicts membership of the query in that class.

arxiv-2108-13369.title: Quantum scattering as a work source
arxiv-2108-13369.creator: Samuel L. Jacob, Massimiliano Esposito, Juan M. R. Parrondo, Felipe Barra
arxiv-2108-13369.description: Abstract We consider a collision between a moving particle and a fixed system, each having internal degrees of freedom. We identify the regime where the motion of the particle acts as a work source for the joint internal system, leading to energy changes which preserve the entropy.

arxiv-2306-06464.title: Polarization coverage and self-healing characteristics of Poincaré-Bessel beam Journal: opticajournal
arxiv-2306-06464.creator: Subith Kumar, Anupam Pal, Arash Shiri, G. K. Samanta, Greg Gbur
arxiv-2306-06464.description: Abstract As a vector version of scalar Bessel beams, Poincaré-Bessel beams (PBBs) have attracted a great deal of attention due to the presence of polarization singularities and their nondiffraction and self-healing properties. Previous studies of PBBs have been restricted primarily to understanding the disinclination patterns in the spatially variable polarization, and many of the properties of PBBs remain unexplored.

arxiv-2312-10749.title: A new behavioral model for portfolio selection using the Half-Full/Half-Empty approach
arxiv-2312-10749.creator: F Cesarone, M Corradini, L Lampariello, J Riccioni
arxiv-2312-10749.description: Abstract We focus on a behavioral model, that has been recently proposed in the literature, whose rational can be traced back to the Half-Full/Half-Empty glass metaphor. More precisely, we generalize the Half-Full/Half-Empty approach to the context of positive and negative lotteries and give financial and behavioral interpretations of the Half-Full/Half-Empty parameters.

arxiv-2404-01976.title: Joint-Task Regularization for Partially Labeled Multi-Task Learning
arxiv-2404-01976.creator: Junsik Kim*, Wanhua Li, Hanspeter Pfister
arxiv-2404-01976.description: Abstract Multi-task learning has become increasingly popular in the machine learning field, but its practicality is hindered by the need for large, labeled datasets. Most multi-task learning methods depend on fully labeled datasets wherein each input example is accompanied by ground-truth labels for all target tasks.

arxiv-2405-10724.title: On Freiman’s Theorem in a function field setting
arxiv-2405-10724.creator: Mieke Wessel
arxiv-2405-10724.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mieke Wessel. We prove some new instances of a conjecture of Bachoc, Couvreur and Zémor that generalizes Freiman’s 3 ​ k − 4 3k-4 Theorem to a multiplicative version in a function field setting.

arxiv-2409-13505.title: Giant Strain Tunability in Polycrystalline Ceramic Films via Helium Implantation
arxiv-2409-13505.creator: A. Blázquez Martínez 1,2,3, S. Glinšek 1,3, T. Granzow 1,3, J.-N. Audinot 1, P. Fertey 4, J. Kreisel 2,3, M. Guennou 2,3, C. Toulouse 1,2,3,5
arxiv-2409-13505.description: Abstract Strain engineering is a powerful tool routinely used to control and enhance properties such as ferroelectricity, magnetic ordering, or metal-insulator transitions. Epitaxial strain in thin films allows manipulation of in-plane lattice parameters, achieving strain values generally up to 4%, and even above in some specific cases.

arxiv-2411-19908.title: Another look at statistical inference with machine learning-imputed data
arxiv-2411-19908.creator: Jessica Gronsbelland, Jianhui Gaoand, Zachary R. McCawand, Yaqi Shiand, David Cheng
arxiv-2411-19908.description: Abstract From structural biology to epidemiology, predictions from machine learning (ML) models increasingly complement costly gold-standard data, enabling faster, more affordable, and scalable scientific inquiry. In response, prediction-based (PB) inference has emerged to support statistical analysis that combines a large volume of predicted data with a small amount of gold-standard data.

arxiv-2509-05064.title: The Game of Graph Nim on graphs with four edges
arxiv-2509-05064.creator: Sayar Karmakar, Moumanti Podder, Souvik Roy, Soumyarup Sadhukhan
arxiv-2509-05064.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sayar Karmakar, Moumanti Podder, Souvik Roy, Soumyarup Sadhukhan. This work is concerned with the study of the Game of Graph Nim – a class of two-player combinatorial games – on graphs with 4 4 edges.

arxiv-2512-15591.title: On right units of special inverse monoids Thanks: The research of the first named author is supported by the Personal Grant F-121 “Problems of combinatorial semigroup and group theory” of the Serbian Academy of Sciences and Arts. The research of the second named author was supported by the EPSRC Fel
arxiv-2512-15591.description: Abstract . We study the class of monoids that arise as the submonoid of right units of finitely presented special inverse monoids. Classical results of Makanin show that the monoids of right units in finitely presented special monoids decompose as a free product of the group of units and a finite rank free monoid.

arxiv-2605-17244.title: Drift Flow Matching
arxiv-2605-17244.creator: Chenrui Ma Xi Xiao Lin Zhao, Tianyang Wang Ferdinando Fioretto Yanning Shen, [0.2cm] University of California, Irvine

pmc-10674758.title: Antiviral Effect and Mechanism of Edaravone against Grouper Iridovirus Infection
pmc-10674758.creator: Jihui Kuang, Mingzhu Liu, Qing Yu, Yuan Cheng, Jing Huang, Shuyu Han, Jingu Shi, Lin Huang, Pengfei Li, Tae-Jin Choi
pmc-10674758.description: Singapore grouper iridovirus (SGIV) is a virus with high fatality rate in the grouper culture industry. The outbreak of SGIV is often accompanied by a large number of grouper deaths, which has a great impact on the economy. Therefore, it is of great significance to find effective drugs against SGIV.

pmc-11282291.title: Cell competition in primary and metastatic colorectal cancer
pmc-11282291.creator: Merel Elise van Luyk, Ana Krotenberg Garcia, Maria Lamprou, Saskia Jacoba Elisabeth Suijkerbuijk
pmc-11282291.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Adult tissues set the scene for a continuous battle between cells, where a comparison of cellular fitness results in the elimination of weaker “loser” cells. This phenomenon, named cell competition, is beneficial for tissue integrity and homeostasis. In fact, cell competition plays a crucial role in tumor suppression, through elimination of early malignant cells, as part of Epithelial Defense Against Cancer. However, it is increasingly apparent that cell competition doubles as a tumor-promoting mechanism.

pmc-11396020.title: Time series and risk factors associated with mortality in women with cervical cancer from 2000 to 2021
pmc-11396020.creator: Talita de Oliveira Lima, José Erialdo da Silva Junior, Giulianna Aparecida Vieira Barreto, Max Wellington Sátiro Justino, Maria Lia Coutinho Carvalho, Marcelo Gurgel Carlos da Silva, Daniele Alves Ferreira, Lúcio Flávio Gonzaga Silva, Paulo Goberlânio de Barros Silva
pmc-11396020.description: Highlights•Cancer cervical has a higher frequency of deaths in women aged over 60.•Cancer cervical has a higher frequency of deaths in indigenous and black.•Cancer cervical has a higher frequency of deaths in with low levels of education. Introduction Cervical cancer is a significant public health problem worldwide.

pmc-11417314.title: Early intervention for obstructive sleep apnoea in Down syndrome – making a difference?
pmc-11417314.creator: Indra Narang, Chun Ting Au
pmc-11417314.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Screening and early intervention for obstructive sleep apnoea in children with Down syndrome is believed to negate its negative impact, and current guidelines recommend universal polysomnography (PSG) screening by the age of 4 years.4 However, given that these recommendations are not evidence-based, the optimal timing for screening and intervention for obstructive sleep apnoea in children with Down syndrome remains an important unanswered clinical question.

pmc-11472953.title: To vaccinate or not to vaccinate? Experiences of COVID-19 vaccine uptake among people living with non-communicable diseases in Ghana: A qualitative study
pmc-11472953.creator: Leonard Baatiema, Sheba M. P. Kunfah, Olutobi A. Sanuade, Luke N. Allen, Seye Abimbola, Ama de-Graft Aikins, Kwadwo A. Koram, Margaret E. Kruk
pmc-11472953.description: Following the development of a vaccine for COVID-19, the expectation was instantaneous widespread distribution and uptake to halt further spread, severe illness and deaths from the virus. However, studies show very low uptake, especially in resource-poor settings, and little is documented about the drivers of vaccine uptake in populations classified as high-risk.

pmc-11615260.title: Three‐dimensional vegetation structure drives patterns of seed dispersal by African hornbills
pmc-11615260.creator: Nicholas J Russo, Docas L Nshom, António Ferraz, Nicolas Barbier, Martin Wikelski, Michael J Noonan, Elsa M Ordway, Sassan Saatchi, Thomas B Smith
pmc-11615260.description: Three‐dimensional (3D) vegetation structure influences animal movements and, consequently, ecosystem functions. Animals disperse the seeds of 60%–90% of trees in tropical rainforests, which are among the most structurally complex ecosystems on Earth.Here, we investigated how 3D rainforest structure influences the movements of large, frugivorous birds and resulting spatial patterns of seed dispersal.

pmc-12467750.title: Sex-Stratified Prediction Models for 5-Year Nonalcoholic Fatty Liver Disease Risk in Thyroid Cancer Patients: A Nationwide Cohort Study
pmc-12467750.creator: Young Bin Cho, Kyoung Sik Park, Yoshinori Nagai
pmc-12467750.description: Background/Objectives: Nonalcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD) is a significant complication among survivors of thyroid cancer; however, existing prediction models for NAFLD remain inadequate. Our objective was to develop survival prediction models for 5-year risk of NAFLD in patients diagnosed with thyroid cancer.

pmc-12491984.title: Modern Endophthalmitis Control: The Complete Early Vitrectomy for Endophthalmitis (CEVE) Protocol and Surgical Prophylaxis
pmc-12491984.creator: Agnieszka J Kudasiewicz-Kardaszewska, Malgorzata A Ozimek, Aleksandra Kardaszewska, Karolina Boninska, Ferenc Kuhn, Slawomir Cisiecki
pmc-12491984.description: This article presents an overview of endophthalmitis, a severe intraocular inflammatory condition that can develop following surgery, intravitreal injections (IVIs), or ocular trauma. Endogenous cases may also arise, particularly in patients with compromised immune systems. A broad spectrum of pathogens, including bacteria, fungi, and viruses, can be involved, with some displaying high virulence.

pmc-12495001.title: Hexagonal Zn1-xMgxS sheds light on the lattice dynamics of atomic alloys
pmc-12495001.creator: Abdelmajid Elmahjoubi, Mala N Rao, Alexandre Ivanov, Andrei V Postnikov, Alain Polian, Toni Alhaddad, Samrath L Chaplot, Andrea Piovano, Sébastien Diliberto, Stéphanie Michel, Alain Maillard, Karol Strzałkowski, Olivier Pagès
pmc-12495001.description: Cubic pseudo-unary A1-xBx high-entropy metallic alloys and pseudo-binary A1-xBxC disordered semiconductor alloys set a benchmark to explore how physical properties are impacted by disorder. Through its diversity, the lattice dynamics offers a unique playground to assign the relevant length scales at which operate various kinds of disorders induced by alloying.

pmc-12709845.title: Factors that inhibit reporting of child maltreatment among dental health personnel – a scoping review
pmc-12709845.creator: Eline Hokstad, Anca Virtej, Ingfrid Vaksdal Brattabø
pmc-12709845.description: BackgroundChild maltreatment impacts the social, physiological, and psychological well-being of affected children, resulting in both short- and long-term consequences. Despite the obligation of dental health personnel to report suspected cases to child welfare services (CWS) or other appropriate authorities, various barriers hinder reporting, leading to underreporting.
